G3_faithfulness.justification: For grades 1 and 2, the formula evaluates to 10 exactly when the endpoint grades differ and to 0 when they are equal, so the rewrite is equivalent to requiring every conflicting pair to receive different shifts.

G4_naturalness.justification: The narrative is coherent and readable, though the elaborate skyscraper terminology and artificial formula make it somewhat contrived.
